sources.title: GitHub - prasithadharshini22/kneeiq-app: KneeIQ — AI that turns a knee ...
sources.snippet: KneeIQ — AI that turns a knee X-ray into a clinician-verified implant size, in one pipeline. Segmentation → measurement → OA correlation → implant matching → AI report → human sign-off. Streamlit + LangChain. From raw knee scan to surgeon-ready implant sizing — one AI pipeline, six solutions, always a human in the loop.
